name: Beta isolation and safe recovery
statement: Preserve production Explorer and records. Gate Beta interface with existing betaModeEnabled. Never replay uncertain writes, duplicate mutations for comparison, or delete an unverified move source. Real lab access is restricted to authorized four-bucket prefixes.
